page: Google Cloud Platform z3-highmem-16-highlssd is a storage-optimized virtual machine built on the x86_64 architecture. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8481C processor operating at 2.7 GHz, delivering 16 dedicated vCPUs across 8 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The instance includes 128 GB of RAM, establishing an 8 GB per vCPU ratio, backed by 105 MB of shared L3 cache and 2 MB of L2 cache per core. High-speed local capacity is provided via 6,442 GB of integrated NVMe SSD storage across two drives. The configuration contains no discrete GPU accelerators and allocates zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results show balanced general compute and strong data throughput. The processor achieves a Geekbench single-core score of 1,691.0 and a multi-core score of 10,293.0, alongside a PassMark CPU score of 21,549.51. Support for AVX-512 and AMX instruction extensions enhances vectorized and matrix operations. Memory throughput tests demonstrate 91.92 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 41.24 GB/sec for writes. In database and transactional evaluations, the server achieves 7,661.44 in PassMark database operations and sustains 17.68 million Redis SET operations per second. CPU-based inference evaluates at 264.49 tokens per second for text generation using a small 135M parameter language model.

The large local NVMe storage allocation provides high density and eliminates external storage latency, presenting favorable qualitative efficiency for I/O-intensive workloads. While compute capacity remains within standard bounds for an 8-core, 16-thread profile, the combination of substantial storage capacity and high RAM per core suits the instance for operational databases, distributed key-value caches like Redis, ETL pipelines, and localized data analytics.
description: Google Cloud Platform z3-highmem-16-highlssd is a storage-optimized instance engineered for data-intensive processing. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8481C processor with 16 dedicated vCPUs across 8 physical cores running at 2.7 GHz, paired with 128 GB of RAM and 105 MB of L3 cache. Storage throughput is driven by 6,442 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD capacity, while GPU accelerators are absent. Benchmark evaluations indicate stable throughput across compute and data tasks, highlighted by 17.68 million Redis SET operations per second, a PassMark database operations score of 7,661.44, and a Geekbench multi-core result of 10,293.0. The configuration provides uncached memory bandwidth of 91.92 GB/sec read and 41.24 GB/sec write. With an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio and high-density local NVMe storage, this instance is suited for high-throughput relational databases, in-memory caching platforms, and demanding ETL data pipelines.
